description: §38.10.3 / §12.2 Trigger 7 (S462 fix round 1) — a `broadcast()` inside a NESTED function declaration places the enclosing `onclient:*` handler on the server (a nested declaration is emitted inline in its parent and is not itself a channel function), so E-CHANNEL-006 fires. Before, the nested call was not seen and the handler shipped to the client calling an undefined `broadcast`.
rationale: §12.2 Trigger 7 places a channel-body function whose body calls `broadcast()`; the nested declaration is part of that body. §38.10.3 refuses an `onclient:*` handler §12.2 places on the server.
